ABOUT US

We attribute our reputation to the lasting customer relationships we’ve developed throughout the years. We believe that all of our customers deserve the highest level of service, and we're committed to providing just that. 
LOPER Painting LLC is a family operated business with more than 22 years of experience in the painting industry field. Our company has unique artistry and craftsmanship that is needed within the industry, always innovating and striving to provide the best quality for every project. We will match your style of a home and make it take on a feeling that matches your vision. Moreover, we use the right materials for your project. Sherwin Williams and Benjamin Moore are the best products being used, having the right tools and colors.  
Get in touch today to learn more about us. Get to know the owner (Ricky Lopez) in person and he'll answer all of your questions. With his unique and cordial treatment as you deserve and help you every step of your own project.
